item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import uno
from com.sun.star.awt import Point, Size

local_ctx = uno.getComponentContext()
resolver = local_ctx.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver', local_ctx)
ctx = resolver.resolve('uno:socket,host=localhost,port=2002;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext')
smgr = ctx.ServiceManager
desktop = smgr.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.frame.Desktop', ctx)
doc = desktop.getCurrentComponent()

pages = doc.getDrawPages()
if pages.getCount() < 2:
    raise SystemExit('Presentation has fewer than 2 slides')
slide1 = pages.getByIndex(0)
slide2 = pages.getByIndex(1)

# Find the visible title on slide 1 and copy its geometry/styling.
title_shape = None
for i in range(slide1.getCount()):
    shape = slide1.getByIndex(i)
    try:
        if 'Sustainable Energy' in shape.getString():
            title_shape = shape
            break
    except Exception:
        pass
if title_shape is None:
    raise SystemExit('Could not find slide 1 title')

pos = title_shape.Position
size = title_shape.Size
text_color = 0xFF0000
char_height = 36.0
font_name = None
try:
    cursor = title_shape.createTextCursor()
    cursor.gotoStart(False)
    cursor.gotoEnd(True)
    text_color = cursor.CharColor
    char_height = cursor.CharHeight
    font_name = cursor.CharFontName
except Exception:
    try:
        text_color = title_shape.CharColor
        char_height = title_shape.CharHeight
        font_name = title_shape.CharFontName
    except Exception:
        pass

# Remove any existing duplicate title on slide 2 to keep the slide clean if rerun.
for i in reversed(range(slide2.getCount())):
    shape = slide2.getByIndex(i)
    try:
        if shape.getString().strip() == 'Online Shopping':
            slide2.remove(shape)
    except Exception:
        pass

new_title = doc.createInstance('com.sun.star.drawing.TextShape')
new_title.Position = Point(pos.X, pos.Y)
new_title.Size = Size(size.Width, size.Height)
slide2.add(new_title)
new_title.setString('Online Shopping')

# Copy title text styling. Use paragraph/cursor properties so Impress renders it as title text.
try:
    new_title.TextAutoGrowHeight = False
    new_title.TextAutoGrowWidth = False
except Exception:
    pass
try:
    new_title.TextVerticalAdjust = uno.Enum('com.sun.star.drawing.TextVerticalAdjust', 'CENTER')
except Exception:
    pass
try:
    new_title.TextHorizontalAdjust = uno.Enum('com.sun.star.drawing.TextHorizontalAdjust', 'CENTER')
except Exception:
    pass
try:
    cursor = new_title.createTextCursor()
    cursor.gotoStart(False)
    cursor.gotoEnd(True)
    cursor.CharColor = text_color
    cursor.CharHeight = char_height
    if font_name:
        cursor.CharFontName = font_name
    cursor.ParaAdjust = uno.Enum('com.sun.star.style.ParagraphAdjust', 'CENTER')
except Exception:
    new_title.CharColor = text_color
    new_title.CharHeight = char_height
    if font_name:
        new_title.CharFontName = font_name

# Select slide 2 in the UI so the requested slide is visible.
controller = doc.getCurrentController()
try:
    controller.setCurrentPage(slide2)
except Exception:
    pass

doc.store()
print(f'Updated slide 2 title: Online Shopping, color #{text_color:06X}, char height {char_height}')
PY"

ctx = resolver.resolve('uno:socket,host=localhost,port=2002;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext')
doc = ctx.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.frame.Desktop', ctx).getCurrentComponent()
slide2 = doc.getDrawPages().getByIndex(1)
for i in range(slide2.getCount()):
    shape = slide2.getByIndex(i)
    try:
        text = shape.getString().strip()
    except Exception:
        continue
    if text:
        color = None
        try:
            c = shape.createTextCursor(); c.gotoStart(False); c.gotoEnd(True); color = c.CharColor
        except Exception:
            pass
        print(text, f'#{color:06X}' if color is not None else '')
PY"
